decision_rule.abandon: Any compliance/leakage failure, dangerous treatment collision, or strict domination without a distinct structural benefit.
decision_rule.keep_or_refine: No leakage/shared-state violation; no dangerous collision; demonstrates at least one nontrivial metric or structural advantage worth follow-up.

hypothesis: A single recursive posterior over learned trajectory prototypes, propagated by action-specific switching operators, can preserve path and treatment-response distinctions without task-specific states or full-history replay.
known_failure_addressed: Existing compact families trade natural-dynamics accuracy, intervention accuracy, and OOD calibration; F18 needs an ensemble and still forces known states on W18.
minimal_complete_change: Add a discrete latent trajectory-prototype posterior, visible-prefix learned row-stochastic natural/action operators, prototype outcome/diagnosis statistics, recursive lag accumulator, and novelty-calibrated abstention as one SharedPatientState.

screen_config.seed_authority: published BENCHMARK_V1_SEED_REVEAL; development-only, not blind confirmation
